clips.ancora: A: Are there good museums in your city?
clips.texto:
Are there good museums in your city?
Yes, there are. There is a museum near the park.
Where can you buy books?
In a bookstore. There is one near the university.
Where can you see movies?
In a movie theater.
Great. I go there on Saturdays.
